items.title: Global sections of a derived tensor product with a constant complex of abelian groups pull the constant factor out
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file etale-cohomology.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261011
items.difficulty_reason: The lemma computes the global sections of E tensor^L_Z underline K as R Gamma(X, E) tensor^L_Z K for a quasi-compact quasi-separated scheme X (statement lines 18937-18946). The proof (proof lines 18948-18998) is a sequence of reductions: a torsion free bounded below representative of K, truncation triangles reducing K to a single flat module and E to a single sheaf, and then Lazard's theorem plus the colimit theorem reducing the flat module to a finite free one, where the identity is trivial. H2: three explicit reduction steps, each written out.
